relationships.subject: CeA PKCδ+ neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Optogenetic activation of PKCδ+ neurons was sufficient to induce mechanical hyperalgesia without changing anxiety-like behavior in naïve mice.

relationships.subject: CeA SOM+ neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: optogenetic inhibition of SOM+ neurons induced mechanical hyperalgesia in naïve mice and increased phosphorylated ERK-positive neurons mainly in PKCδ+ neurons

relationships.subject: CeA SOM+ neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: optogenetic inhibition of SOM+ neurons induced mechanical hyperalgesia in naïve mice and increased phosphorylated ERK-positive neurons mainly in PKCδ+ neurons

relationships.subject: CeA SOM+ neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Optogenetic activation of SOM+ neurons slightly reduced the mechanical hyperalgesia in the pain model but did not change the mechanical sensitivity in naïve mice. Instead, it induced anxiety-like behavior.

key_findings: Activation of CeA PKCδ+ neurons induced mechanical hyperalgesia and their inhibition reduced formalin-model hyperalgesia.
Inhibiting CeA SOM+ neurons induced hyperalgesia and pERK in PKCδ+ neurons; activating them induced anxiety-like behavior.
